description: X5.14: load-position servo of a compliant drivetrain (first shaft mode ~3.9 Hz, damping ~0.04). The plant is a pure bond graph (MSe, I, R, GY, TF, C, 0/1-junctions). `drivetrain-position` is a 1 kHz firmware (smooth trajectory, Kalman filter on two encoders, feedforward, LQR with integral action); `naive` is a textbook PID on the motor-side position; `drivetrain-position-open-loop` compares the plant with the ODE of design/design.py.

checks.note: rest before the step: the load angle stays at zero (the reference and the estimator start at zero, so nothing moves)
rest before the step: the load speed stays at zero

load position settles in the 0.02 rad (2 %) band by 0.9 s after the step (predicted 0.661 s: the 0.8 s trajectory plus the tail) with overshoot below 2 % (predicted 0.60 %); limits are about 1.3 times the prediction
just before the disturbance the load is at 1 rad within 5 mrad (the load encoder LSB is 0.38 mrad)
residual oscillation after settling: peak-to-peak below 4 mrad (predicted 0.33 mrad, about 10 encoder LSB of the load; the shaft mode is damped, not ringing)
the 0.2 N m load torque (a 0.17 rad static twist) dips the load by at most 0.092 rad (predicted dip 0.057 rad)
the disturbance is rejected: the load is back within 10 mrad of 1 rad 1 s after it (predicted recovery into the 20 mrad band after 0.130 s)
the motor voltage stays inside the 24 V supply limit (predicted peak 13.6 V)
the Kalman filter has learned the 0.2 N m load torque (5 %)
the estimate follows the load angle within 3 mrad RMS over the whole move
closed-loop prediction of design.py (exact 5-state truth with the 1 mH inductance, 12/14-bit encoders); 4 mrad tolerance for the solver and the encoder phase

no solver failure, causal conflict, event-limit stop or invalid unit. W201 (IW1/IJm in derivative causality: the ideal gear welds the two inertias) and W205 (dimensionless bond island) are expected bond-graph causality
the contrast is real: the first load peak is at least 1.835 rad, an overshoot of 84 % or more (predicted 2.044 rad at 0.363 s; the showcase overshoots by 0.60 %)
and it is still ringing 1.6 s later: the peak near 1.93 s is above 1.281 rad (predicted 1.468); the showcase is still inside 5 mrad
the load rings at the shaft mode, about 3.83 Hz (open-loop mode 3.91 Hz, motor held 3.90 Hz)
the naive loop saturates on the step but stays inside 24 V
